products.title: Colombia Huila Finca El Paraiso Pink Bourbon (Green Coffee)
products.body_html:
Region: Huila
Producer: Diego Bermudez
Varietal: Pink Bourbon
Process: Thermal shock anaerobic
Altitude: 1900 masl
Tasting Notes: lychee, rose, bubblegum

From the famous Finca El Paraiso.

products.title: Ethiopia Yirgacheffe Aricha Natural G1 (Green Coffee)
products.body_html: This natural process Yirgacheffe from the Aricha washing station is grown at 1900-2100 masl by smallholder farmers. Heirloom varietals. Expect blueberry and jasmine.
